patch:
@@ -0,0 +1,8 @@
+# Glimmung vendors the generic live-preview-edge library partial into
+# charts/live-preview-edge/ at preview-provision time (a cluster ConfigMap, NOT
+# an oci:// Helm dependency — ACR is Basic SKU; NOT a committed copy). The slot
+# chart includes the partial's named templates gated on livePreview.enabled and
+# declares no Helm dependency, so a normal/CI/prod/validation render never needs
+# the library. This keeps any locally-vendored copy out of git.
+# See glimmung docs/live-preview-plan.md "Stage 4a landed contracts".
+charts/

@@ -7,7 +7,13 @@ metadata:
   labels:
     app: {{ include "kill-me.resourceName" . }}
 spec:
-  replicas: 1
+  # Single serving pod. When livePreview is enabled the live-preview-edge.replicas
+  # helper returns 1 and FAILS the render on requested>1 (a per-pod emptyDir
+  # override behind replicas>1 flickers the co-watched frontend, v1 #1419). The
+  # include is GATED on enabled so the chart renders standalone WITHOUT the
+  # vendored library on a normal/CI/validation install (where it stays 1,
+  # byte-identical to today); Glimmung vendors the library only on a preview lease.
+  replicas: {{ if .Values.livePreview.enabled }}{{ include "live-preview-edge.replicas" (dict "spec" .Values.livePreview "requested" 1) }}{{ else }}1{{ end }}
   selector:
     matchLabels:
       app: {{ include "kill-me.resourceName" . }}
@@ -28,7 +34,13 @@ spec:
           image: "{{ .Values.image.repository }}:{{ .Values.image.tag }}"
           imagePullPolicy: {{ .Values.image.pullPolicy }}
           ports:
-            - name: http
+            # When a live-preview edge fronts the backend, the edge owns the
+            # "http" served port and the backend's own port is renamed to an
+            # internal name (kill-me.appPortName) to avoid a duplicate port name
+            # in the pod. The container port NUMBER (3000) is unchanged, so the
+            # edge's loopback upstream still targets :3000. Without the edge the
+            # name stays "http", so normal/validation renders are byte-identical.
+            - name: {{ include "kill-me.appPortName" . }}
               containerPort: 3000
           env:
             - name: PORT
@@ -45,19 +57,32 @@ spec:
           startupProbe:
             httpGet:
               path: /health
-              port: http
+              port: {{ include "kill-me.appPortName" . }}
             periodSeconds: 5
             failureThreshold: 20
           readinessProbe:
             httpGet:
               path: /health
-              port: http
+              port: {{ include "kill-me.appPortName" . }}
             periodSeconds: 10
             failureThreshold: 3
           livenessProbe:
             httpGet:
               path: /health
-              port: http
+              port: {{ include "kill-me.appPortName" . }}
             periodSeconds: 30
             failureThreshold: 3
+        {{- /*
+        The live-preview edge, in front of the backend. Gated on
+        livePreview.enabled (off by default → renders nothing), so this changes
+        nothing on a normal/validation install. When enabled it becomes the
+        pod's served port and reverse-proxies the backend on :3000.
+        */ -}}
+        {{- if .Values.livePreview.enabled }}
+        {{- include "live-preview-edge.container" .Values.livePreview | nindent 8 }}
+        {{- end }}
+      {{- if .Values.livePreview.enabled }}
+      volumes:
+        {{- include "live-preview-edge.volume" .Values.livePreview | nindent 8 }}
+      {{- end }}
 {{- end }}

@@ -13,6 +13,11 @@ spec:
   ports:
     - name: http
       port: 80
-      targetPort: http
+      # Served port: the live-preview edge when livePreview is enabled (it fronts
+      # the backend), the backend's own port ("http") otherwise. The include is
+      # GATED on enabled so the chart renders standalone WITHOUT the vendored
+      # library on a normal/CI/validation install (targetPort stays "http",
+      # byte-identical to today); Glimmung vendors the library on a preview lease.
+      targetPort: {{ if .Values.livePreview.enabled }}{{ include "live-preview-edge.servedPortName" (dict "spec" .Values.livePreview "appPortName" (include "kill-me.appPortName" .)) }}{{ else }}http{{ end }}
       protocol: TCP
 {{- end }}

@@ -19,6 +19,52 @@ testEnv:
 serviceAccount: infra-shared
 serviceAccountClientId: 2ba3e252-c553-4a57-8811-c29b51c06cd9
 
+# Live-preview lane (glimmung docs/live-preview-plan.md). OFF by default: a
+# normal/prod, CI, or validation (warm/hot) install renders no edge, so this
+# changes NOTHING until Glimmung sets livePreview.enabled=true on a preview
+# lease. When enabled, the generic live-preview-edge library partial runs the
+# edge in front of kill-me's own backend: the edge becomes the served port, the
+# app backend listens internally on its own port (3000), and the edge serves the
+# dev's freshly-pushed frontend override-first (fresh-preview passthrough to the
+# stable backend). The partial is vendored into charts/live-preview-edge/ by
+# Glimmung's preview install Job (a cluster ConfigMap), NOT a committed copy and
+# NOT a Helm dependency — every reference is gated on livePreview.enabled so the
+# chart renders standalone without the library. Glimmung --sets image.tag,
+# upstream.url, authorizedSubject, and backendPrefixes per preview lease. The
+# single-serving-pod invariant (replicas=1) is enforced by the
+# live-preview-edge.replicas helper.
+#
+# AUTH: the edge validates pushes against auth.romaine.life JWKS (public RS256
+# keys fetched over HTTPS); it needs only outbound HTTPS to auth.romaine.life,
+# which the slot pod already has. No projected SA token is added to the pod.
+livePreview:
+  enabled: false
+  image:
+    repository: romainecr.azurecr.io/glimmung-live-preview-edge
+    # Empty by default — Glimmung --sets the fingerprint-pinned tag from its
+    # control-plane Settings at provision time. The live-preview-edge.container
+    # helper fails the render if this is empty while enabled, so a missing edge
+    # image surfaces loudly rather than as a silent ImagePull.
+    tag: ""
+    pullPolicy: IfNotPresent
+  port: 8080
+  servedPortName: http
+  upstream:
+    # kill-me's backend listens internally on :3000 (== live_preview.backend_port);
+    # the edge reverse-proxies to it on loopback.
+    url: "http://127.0.0.1:3000"
+  # Request path prefixes the edge always proxies to the backend (kill-me's API
+  # and health routes). Everything else is served override-first by the edge.
+  # Glimmung --sets this from the project's live_preview.backend_prefixes.
+  backendPrefixes: []
+  # The auth.romaine.life JWT subject permitted to push/delete an override.
+  # Glimmung --sets it to the preview lease owner per provision.
+  authorizedSubject: ""
+  override:
+    volumeName: live-preview-override
+    mountPath: /var/run/glimmung-live-preview
+  resources: {}
+
 ingress:
   gatewayName: main
   gatewayNamespace: envoy-gateway-system
